values.note: Electric sites $30 a night ($180 a week), rustic sites without electric $20 ($75 a week); one rate for everyone (no resident discount posted). Dump station only, for non-campers: $10. Payment is due on arrival; additional campers or tents beyond one camper and one tent per site are charged the nightly rate.

note: Village of Kaleva municipal roadside park & campground at 14126 9 Mile Road, electric and rustic sites around a loop drive with a pavilion, ball field and playground. A base for anglers in the fall salmon and spring steelhead runs and for hunters; hosts Kaleva Days (3rd weekend of July) and Juhannus (around June 21). No open fires or fireworks. --Claude
